$comment: Schema features a Pages document can use beyond the baseline. Every mark and block type without a feature is baseline, and a document that uses only baseline carries no stamp. A writer adds a feature's id to the document's schema.features in the same Automerge change that first writes content needing it; a reader whose build lacks an id opens the Page read-only. A mark names its feature in marks.json; a block type is listed under its feature's blocks here. JavaScript (model/schema-features.mjs) and Rust (crates/nteract-rich-text) both read this file. Add features; never remove one or reuse an id.

features.description: Strikethrough text: the strike mark, written ~~text~~ in Markdown.
Horizontal rules between blocks, written --- in Markdown.
The Page host converted the Page's preserved Markdown blocks to native rich text. A build without this feature may still write or convert preserved blocks, so it opens the Page read-only.
The Page's comments live in their own Automerge document, not in the Page document. A build without this feature would write comments into the Page document, so it opens the Page read-only.
